whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Antisocial,

I noticed your cafe & banquet has strong 4.0★ reviews with 230+ guests in Patliputra Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and private event inquiries.

Maine aapke venue ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, banquet inquiry form, aur food/cafe menu integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/antisocial

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Antisocial, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe aur banquet ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table bookings and mobile-first banquet inquiries for your Patliputra Colony location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu details aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
